meta.title: The Odyssey — Immanent Dialogue Block Atlas
meta.primary_purpose: generate character speech for each scene, not generate stage composition
meta.source_precision_note: Book-level PDF anchors are retained. Turn plans are derived from atlas beats and must not be treated as exact line-level quotation alignment.

theory.definition: a performable speech component that joins speech act, speaker knowledge, traditional referentiality, social protocol, audience competence, and state consequence
theory.core_equation: P(next utterance block) ∝ speaker voice × speech-act fit × scene state × protocol pressure × traditional association × audience recognizability × continuity consequence
theory.central_invariant: what a character says must arise from what that character can know, want, conceal, invoke, and change at that exact scene state
theory.communicative_economy: small surface utterance activates a larger shared traditional field without requiring modern exposition
theory.type_script_role: exchange scripts organize multi-turn speech events such as xenia, counsel, assembly contest, deception, prophecy, and recognition

UTTERANCE.EPITHET.role: activate a traditional identity field in compact form

UTTERANCE.STANCE.role: declare emotion, certainty, obligation, or authority

UTTERANCE.CLAIM.role: assert a proposition that may update scene truth

UTTERANCE.QUESTION.role: open a knowledge slot to be filled by an addressee

UTTERANCE.IMPERATIVE.role: attempt to create an action obligation

UTTERANCE.EVIDENCE.role: support identity, accusation, prophecy, or report

UTTERANCE.PROTOCOL_MARKER.role: invoke xenia, kinship, oath, assembly, kleos, or divine law

UTTERANCE.CONSEQUENCE.role: project the future produced by compliance or refusal

UTTERANCE.TRADITIONAL_HYPERLINK.role: activate a large inherited field without exposition

UTTERANCE.NARRATIVE_BRIDGE.role: move from one event or time layer to another

UTTERANCE.LINE_CLOSE.role: commit the utterance and hand state to the next turn

SPEECH_ACT.GREETING.function: open social relation and recognize presence

SPEECH_ACT.QUESTION.function: request missing identity, motive, evidence, or news

SPEECH_ACT.ASSERTION.function: place a claim into shared scene state

SPEECH_ACT.IDENTITY_CLAIM.function: declare or fabricate speaker identity and provenance

SPEECH_ACT.COUNSEL.function: alter another character’s future action through strategic instruction

SPEECH_ACT.COMMAND.function: create an obligation for an addressee

SPEECH_ACT.REBUKE.function: name a violated norm and assign blame

SPEECH_ACT.BOAST.function: inflate speaker capability or status before witnesses

SPEECH_ACT.THREAT.function: make a future harm conditionally present

SPEECH_ACT.PROPHECY.function: bind present signs to a future state

SPEECH_ACT.PRAYER.function: address divine power and request intervention

SPEECH_ACT.OATH.function: bind speaker credibility to a sacred or social consequence

SPEECH_ACT.LAMENT.function: make loss socially audible and reactivate absent relations

SPEECH_ACT.SUPPLICATION.function: place a vulnerable speaker under another’s protection

SPEECH_ACT.PERSUASION.function: reframe a choice by joining desire, norm, and consequence

SPEECH_ACT.DECEPTION.function: produce a strategically useful false or partial world model

SPEECH_ACT.RECOGNITION_TEST.function: test identity through privileged signs or impossible knowledge

SPEECH_ACT.NARRATIVE_REPORT.function: reconstruct absent events for an audience inside the story

SPEECH_ACT.ASSEMBLY_ADDRESS.function: convert private injury into public claim and proposed action

SPEECH_ACT.INVOCATION.function: authorize performance through a superhuman memory source

SPEECH_ACT.NEGOTIATION.function: trade obligations, gifts, passage, or restraint

SPEECH_ACT.FAREWELL.function: close a relation while projecting future continuity

SPEECH_ACT.SILENCE.function: withhold speech as an active social operation

avoid: psychological diagnosis not supported by scene

biases: contrast mortal blame with chosen action
compare present comfort with Trojan loss

VOICE.EUMAEUS.syntax: direct practical clauses and moral evaluation

VOICE.EORYCLEIA.syntax: maternal protest and recognition through body knowledge

VOICE.ACHILLES.register: heroic magnitude shadowed by death knowledge
VOICE.ACHILLES.syntax: direct valuation of life, glory, and loss

CONTROL.COMPRESS.effect: remove explicit exposition while retaining a recognizable traditional trigger

CONTROL.EXPAND.effect: unfold a referential field into locally necessary detail

CONTROL.CONCEAL.effect: withhold identity or motive while preserving truth anchors

CONTROL.TEST.effect: generate a question or sign whose answer can verify identity, loyalty, or knowledge

CONTROL.REPEAT_WITH_DIFFERENCE.effect: reuse a formula or scene pattern under changed moral conditions

CONTROL.INTERRUPT.effect: break an expected exchange script to create meaning through deviation

CONTROL.COMMIT.effect: make the utterance consequential for later turns and scenes
